title: Reflex record
description: Each time an instruction is said (a reflex among them), which one, to which run and where (its for place), kept on this pack's own stream; and, read back, how often each was said and whether the misses it answers (refusals of a phrase it names, beats about what it answers) came back in a run after it was said there. Said by the agents pack as it says them (the read said_here); read as said_record, by the reflex_view rows and an agent's query. Split from reflex, which keeps the words. It also reads the misses (refusals, bumps, traps) with where each happened and what covers it (misses), asks an agent at a reply's end to write a trial reflex for a refusal nothing covers (rule write_node), and each hour promotes or retires reflexes by their record (thresholds in its memory, key thresholds: promote_held, retire_failed, retire_unsaid_days).

rules.say: Each instruction said, to which run and where, 90 days of it.
A refusal no reflex covers came up: search for one, then write a trial reflex (for = where, misses = its words, note = what fixed it), or say why not.

views.description: How often each of some instructions was said, to how many runs and where, and per run whether a miss it answers came back after it was said there (failed), stopped (held: a miss before, none after) or never showed (quiet), and whose it is (tier: core, pack, owner or learned). Params: ids (required, at most 50), days (how far back, 30 unless said, 90 at most).

Every miss lately, the newest first: refusals on runs' stories, bumps (issues kept as problems) and traps (instructions said for files), each with its kind, run, when, where it happened (for place) and the open nodes that cover it (covered_by; none, uncovered). Params: days (30 unless said, 90 at most).
